title: Photon-Emission-Guided Laser Fault Injection Enables RP2350 Secure Debug
summary: Ledger's security research team discovered a novel attack technique combining photon emission microscopy with laser fault injection to bypass secure debug protections on Raspberry Pi's RP2350 microcontroller. By using the chip's photon emissions as a trigger signal for precise laser timing, they achieved reliable fault injection during the debug authentication process, potentially enabling extraction of flash contents and debug credentials.
problem_solved: Enables bypassing secure debug authentication on RP2350 by using photon emission as a precise timing guide for laser fault injection attacks.
why_valuable: Demonstrates a new class of attacks combining side-channel signals with fault injection, providing critical security insights for hardware manufacturers and helping the industry develop more robust countermeasures against physical attacks.
